label: Profile Silhouette
description: A side-angle take becomes a dark silhouette with a thin rim light on a flat color background that changes at story beats. A front take supplies the voice.

shotRules.cutFrequency: The background changes at story beats, on a sentence.
shotRules.camera: None. The silhouette stays where it was filmed.
shotRules.characters: One dark figure, side on, with a thin rim light.
shotRules.sound: No transition sounds, ever. The recording's own voice carries the video.

slots.label: Side-angle take
slots.hint: Filmed from the side, against anything: the background goes.

slots.label: Front take (the voice)
slots.hint: Gives the sound. Without it the side take's own sound is used.

templates.label: Color beat
templates.when: A new part of the story.
